name: de.dachdeals/deals
title: DachDeals – geprüfte Amazon-Deals
description: Live Amazon.de deals for DE/AT/CH, verified against own price history, plus price checks.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: EN: Search current Amazon.de deals (Germany/Austria/Switzerland) verified by DachDeals against its own price history. Use when someone asks for deals, discounts or bargains for a product or category. Returns price with price_updated_at, discount, price_check (lowest/good/normal/high), confidence, a reason and the deal page to link. DE: Aktuelle, geprüfte Amazon.de-Angebote suchen.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: EN: Is this a good price right now? Price check for any product on Amazon.de by name or ASIN – also without a current deal – from DachDeals' own price measurements: latest price, price_check (lowest/good/normal/high), confidence, reason (e.g. "19 % below the 90-day median"), lowest/median price. DE: Preisprüfung für jedes Produkt.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: EN: Full daily price history for an Amazon ASIN (DE, IT, FR, ES, UK) from DachDeals' own measurements with a price assessment. DE: Preisverlauf für eine ASIN.
